headline: Jubilant Pharmova radiopharma unit to invest CAD 94.5 million to double RUBY-FILL production
hook: Capacity doubling for core radiopharma product
summary: Jubilant Pharmova's radiopharma division is investing CAD 94.5 million to modernise and expand its Kirkland, Québec facility in Canada. The expansion is designed to double the production capacity of RUBY-FILL. The Government of Canada is providing CAD 23.8 million in financial support for the project. For Indian retail investors, this capital expenditure drives global manufacturing scale for a specialised pharmaceutical segment.
why_it_matters: Global manufacturing scale expands for Jubilant's radiopharma business
